name: SP3 第一个囚徒·叶王（人物传VOL.2）
desc: 2026 暑假特辑·人物传 VOL.2 高级档（传主：叶王） · 15 道自包含单选（反义疑问 never/where 定从/would rather/stop doing/find it/used to/each of/两门比较级/双冠词读音/stop from doing/交际拒绝/neither 倒装/过去进行/It takes/图证反选）。传记阅读与航的答卷在纸卷上。

m5.q: 6. The Queen never makes mistakes now, ___ she?
m5.why: 正确：never 使前句为否定 → 后肯 does she。

m5.q: 7. The palace is a place ___ every answer must be perfect.
m5.why: 正确：从句不缺主宾 → 关系副词 where。

m5.q: 8. She would rather keep one mistake than ___ the door.
m5.why: 正确：would rather A than B，两端都用原形。

m5.q: 9. At the academy she stopped ___ questions — that was the first brick of the wall.
m5.why: 正确：停止提问 → stop asking。

m5.q: 10. Visitors find ___ hard to say no to the Queen.
m5.why: 正确：find it hard to do 固定结构。

m5.q: 11. She ___ be a student like you — few believe it now.
m5.why: 正确：过去曾是 → used to be。

m5.q: 12. Each of the four tokens on the wall ___ its own story.
m5.why: 正确：each 作主语核心 → 单数 tells。

m5.q: 13. Of the two doors in the hall, ___ one leads to the secret room.
m5.why: 正确：of the two → the smaller。

m5.q: 14. Behind the curtain there is ___ old desk and ___ one-mistake paper.
15. No guard can stop new letters ___ to the palace.
16. — May I look behind the curtain? — ___ , young snake.
17. Hang has never seen behind the curtain, and ___ have the others.
m5.why: 正确：前句否定 → neither have the others。

m5.q: 18. When the last visitor left at midnight, the Queen ___ the new letters.
m5.why: 正确：午夜那一刻正在读 → 过去进行。

m5.q: 19. It takes real courage ___ at the palace gate.
m5.why: 正确：It takes courage to do。

m5.q: 20. 对照王座厅再读四句——只有一句有语法错误。选出【错误】的一句：
ops: The curtain of the side room is half open.
The number of letters on the steps are growing.
There is one paper on the old desk.
The crown on the throne has a red gem.
m5.why: 正确（此句有错）：the number of… → is growing。
